About me

The student behind the screens.

I'm a third year BS Information Technology student majoring in Software Development Technologies, with a focus on front end development. I like turning a Figma design into a clean, working interface that feels good on any screen.

Beyond the browser, I've built desktop apps in Java, database-driven systems in PHP and MySQL, and AI experiments with Teachable Machine and MediaPipe. I plan my projects with Gantt charts and UML diagrams so the build goes smoothly.
